Smoke test: load baml and parse a simple snippet

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"baml\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "class Person {\n  name string\n  age int\n}\n\nenum Level {\n  Junior\n  Senior\n}\n\nfunction Greet(p: Person) -> string {\n  p.name\n}\n", config: configObj)
print(result)
```
